note: The plate the game draws a gift's name on, one per sin (#786), written by tools/gift_plates.py: sprite MainUI_MirrorDungeon3_3_1 (the Image NamePanel/img_namePlate of the game's gift panels) times the sin's colour in UIColorManager, as the game tints it. colour: the game's; shade: what the colour is multiplied by so the ink holds 4.6:1; ink: the name's ink (inks); contrast: the least the ink reaches against the plate where the name can go (the sprite's middle half in height, all but 8 % at each end in width, halftone included). border: the sprite's slice border in its pixels (top, right, bottom, left).
